rules: Only actual project-authored capture evidence may be added.
Every reference entry uses a unique immutable id.
Every usable entry must include owner_review=accepted; pending remains experimental and cannot be used as a quantitative production reference.
Every entry binds capture_manifest {path, sha256}, candidate_sha256, asset_sha256, runtime_commit, source_image_sha256 and mask_sha256 as a complete role-to-SHA-256 map.
A replacement reference is appended as a new entry; never mutate or delete the superseded record to hide a regression.
Synthetic detector fixtures, generated images, V-series images and third-party images are prohibited.
Presence of a repository file outside this inventory does not make it a reference.
note: Empty by design. Presence of a file outside this inventory does not make it a visual QA reference.
